description: This file contains unit tests for parsing Git trailer lines, including functions to iterate over trailer entries and various test cases for different trailer formats and edge cases.

methods.name: t_trailer_iterator
methods.description: Iterates over trailer lines in a message and asserts their correctness against expected contents.

methods.name: test_trailer__empty_input
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with empty input.

methods.name: test_trailer__no_newline_start
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with input starting without a newline.

methods.name: test_trailer__newline_start
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with input starting with a newline.

methods.name: test_trailer__no_body_text
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with input that has no body text before trailers.

methods.name: test_trailer__body_text_no_divider
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with body text and multiple trailers.

methods.name: test_trailer__body_no_divider_2nd_block
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with multiple trailer blocks, including precedence rules.

methods.name: test_trailer__body_and_divider
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with a divider line and trailers.

methods.name: test_trailer__non_trailer_in_block
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with non-trailer lines in a trailer block.

methods.name: test_trailer__too_many_non_trailers
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with a block below the 25% trailer threshold.

methods.name: test_trailer__one_non_trailer_no_git_trailers
methods.description: Tests trailer parser with mostly non-trailer lines, not considered a trailer block.
